name: facetime
notes: MacBook Pro 13in M2 (Mac14,7) built-in camera. Modes 1280x720 and 640x480 only, 15-30 fps. Fixed focus; exposure and white balance automatic only (macOS exposes no manual or locked modes) and no lens intrinsics or field of view. Measured 24 fps at 1280x720 under indoor light: auto-exposure lengthens exposures and drops the rate - more light brings it back to 30. Calibrate at 1280x720 and run at that mode: 640x480 is a crop or rescale with different intrinsics.
